description: k86: a config error through the hooks – SessionStart answers the one line naming the file and touches nothing; the background sync leaves exactly that line as its report, never "changes applied"; the next prompt hands it out with no context, the prompt after is silent. The project's check mark in home/.claude/skilletor/last-check.json lies in the future, so no prompt is due: a config that fails to load would otherwise make one due every 600 s and start a real background sync.
